card.name: Unanimous and overwhelming agreement words
card.fires_on: The word unanimous or its pieces (Unanim-, -ously, -ous), and the word overwhelming, when describing votes, verdicts or majorities in general web text.

modes.label: Unanimous and its pieces
modes.description: Fires on the word unanimous, or part of it, describing a vote, verdict or decision.
modes.example: twelve jurors reached a<< unanimous>> verdict on December 8, 1

modes.label: Overwhelming as degree word
modes.description: Fires on overwhelming or overwhelmingly describing majorities or evidence.
modes.example: the<< overwhelming>> majority of American women have chosen to give

card.writes: It promotes unanimous and similar agreement words, so it pushes the model toward words about full agreement.
card.plain: It lights up on words like unanimous and overwhelming that describe how fully people agree.
